name: Suzy Fox
source:
Pilot of the Strawberry Dragoon.

A hardworking and caring spaniel with a serious streak. An experienced pilot, having served the Lilac for multiple years. Is the second in command of the squadron, and performs all the clerical work. Tries her best to support her subordinates, but hides a quiet dread about the harsh reality of their circumstances. Mom of the team.

Sign: Taurus
Favourite Food: Fried Egg.
Hobbies: I don't have time for anything like that.
Likes: Attentive people, Methodical work.
Dislikes: Tries her best to like everything, but is annoyed by people who ignore the rules. (Ayane)

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
